stem: A sample must be moved from a suspect room for authorized identification. What is the best practice?
choices: Use the facility's labeled containment and sample-transfer procedure to prevent unnecessary exposure
Carry the sample uncovered so it can be observed easily
Place it in a shared pocket
Leave it on a clean-room workbench until someone collects it
rationale: Controlled sample handling preserves identity and limits the chance of creating a new contamination pathway.
